title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Aft Mount — Install the Spherical Bearing and Cut the Heat Shield Inspection Window

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Converts the auxiliary power unit aft mount to the self-aligning spherical bearing and cuts an inspection window in the aft heat shield, halving the inspection interval cost and removing the shield drop.

sections.planning_reason: The steel link and replaceable bush of the first standard removed the link replacement cost but not the wear itself, and high utilisation operators were still finding bushes at the limit at each heat check. Measurement on twelve aircraft found a consistent angular misalignment at the aft attachment produced by thermal growth of the tail cone structure, which a plain bush cannot accept. Operators also reported that the inspection cannot be done without dropping the aft heat shield, which adds six hours to a two hour task.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to replace the plain bushes with a self-aligning spherical bearing at the aft end of the link, to re-machine the outer end of the steel link to accept the bearing housing, to re-bore the bracket, to install the bearing seal and to add the clamp that restrains the drain line displaced by the larger housing. An inspection window is cut in the aft heat shield and closed with a removable panel so that the bearing can be examined without dropping the shield.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Confirm from the configuration record that the aircraft carries the steel link. Open the tail cone access doors and drop the aft heat shield for this accomplishment only. Remove the aft link and take it to the shop. Re-machine the outer end to the profile given in the installation drawing and confirm against the gauge. Re-bore the bracket to the new housing outside diameter. Install the spherical bearing housing on the link and fit the bearing seal. Reinstall the link and torque the attachments to the values in AMM-T-49-10-12-400-002-A. Install the clamp on the drain line clear of the housing. Cut the inspection window in the aft heat shield using the template supplied, deburr and treat the cut edge, and fit the removable panel. Reinstall the heat shield. Do the mount inspection through the new window to establish the baseline. Close the access doors and record the modification.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all TITAN-88 aircraft that carry the steel link, either through the cancelled first bulletin or from the production line at MSN T00122 and later. Aircraft delivered from MSN T00205 have the spherical bearing from the line. An aircraft still on the original aluminium link cannot take this bulletin without the steel link content, which is included in the first eight steps.
sections.material_note: Kit K4910-1013-01 covers one aircraft and includes the heat shield template. The spherical bearing is a twenty-four week lead item. Revision 02 added the steel link and firewall panel to the kit so that aircraft which never took the cancelled bulletin can be converted in one visit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled auxiliary power unit mount inspection, or within 48 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Steel link and firewall panel added to the kit for aircraft that never embodied the cancelled first bulletin; heat shield template part reference corrected
